column2: Note: The positive control strain carries a deletion at the pfs locus, and is viable in M9 media

Cells were inoculated on day 0 at a total initial density of 1.5E7 cells/ml, or 7.5E6 cells/ml for each individual strain. Cell density was measured by OD each day over 4 days, in two biological replicates. At the end of 4 days cultures were diluted 1:100 and the ratio of mCherry-labeled to Venus-labeled strains was determined by flow cytometry of 50μl samples. See the manuscript text for additional details.

Sheets Day1_Rep1 through Day4_Rep2 report the total cell density in each coculture after each day and for each biological replicate. Units are cells/ml. The row of each matrix corresponds to the mCherry-labeled strain and the column to the venus-labeled strain. Sheets Venus_Counts and mCherry_Counts report the total counts of Venus and mCherry labeled cells, after 4 days, in each well of the first biological replicate.
